mapper.sql: SELECT s.id, s.session_no, s.business_domain_id, d.name AS business_domain_name, s.customer_id, s.session_status, s.assigned_to, s.last_message_at, s.closed_at, s.created_at, s.updated_at, COALESCE(( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM consultation_message m WHERE m.consultation_session_id = s.id ), 0) AS message_count, ( SELECT t.ticket_no FROM consultation_ticket_link l JOIN ticket t ON t.id = l.ticket_id WHERE l.consultation_session_id = s.id LIMIT 1 ) AS linked_ticket_no FROM consultation_session s JOIN business_domain d ON d.id = s.business_domain_id
mapper.select: SELECT m.id, m.consultation_session_id, m.business_domain_id, s.session_no, m.seq_no, m.sender_user_id, m.sender_role, m.message_type, m.content, CAST(m.payload AS CHAR) AS payload_json, m.created_at FROM consultation_message m JOIN consultation_session s ON s.id = m.consultation_session_id WHERE m.consultation_session_id = #{sessionId} ORDER BY m.seq_no
SELECT t.ticket_no FROM consultation_ticket_link l JOIN ticket t ON t.id = l.ticket_id WHERE l.consultation_session_id = #{sessionId} LIMIT 1
